Well, if MAV can survive PvP then no reason why SF can't cause of same dura. comments.author: Lancelot
comments.body:
WR only affects max speed since battle ships rarely reach max speed in battle due to turn -speed getting crit -speed and melee resets speed so WR isn't important EVEN IF the max speed effect applies in battle, same goes for vert/hori sails not a huge deal even in battle.

Rigorous tests on Asian servers show:
Armor affect intensity of each acceleration burst
Cargo affect frequency or gap between each acceleration burst
Number of sails PROBABLY affect intensity of acceleration burst as in MAV with 4 sails supposed to hav worse acceleration than MFCV with only 3 sails
As you can see MAV with "bonus" cargo and not so high armor and 4 sails is supposed to be slow but it is not slow so it's inferred different ships hav different inherent acceleration, the previous points about cargo/armor apply to same ship only as testing was done on same ship type with varying cargo/armor
